title: Therefore Done
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：therefore　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 therefore 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Therefore, in 1992 the elder followed the staff at the gate, and everybody in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the elder had ② therefore followed the staff, and nobody had asked a single question. The elder had come to the village two years earlier, and spoke little of the village he had left behind him.

The memoir for November 1986 puts it plainer. The staff was ③ therefore necessary, and the youth who kept it had ④ therefore kept it twice before the winter came; nothing in the village was ever done therefore in those days. The youth wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else. He followed the staff ⑤ therefore on the same day, and nobody in the village doubted it; of all who followed it that year, he followed it ⑥ therefore with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the village had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1999 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was that the staff be kept ⑦ therefore every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ therefore careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done therefore.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2002 she followed the staff ⑨ therefore with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Therefore, she said in 2004, that was the part the village never forgot; the memoir still speaks therefore of it. She kept the staff in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the village never forgot how therefore it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 因此（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had therefore followed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 因此（修饰形容词：therefore necessary）
C. adv. 所以（评注性状语，置于句首：Therefore, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 所以（修饰过去分词：had therefore kept it）
E. adv. 因此（句末状语：… therefore on the same day）
F. adv. 因此（句末状语：… therefore with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 所以（被动结构中的中位状语：be kept therefore）
H. adv. 所以（修饰形容词：be therefore careful about the whole business）

items.q: therefore on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: therefore 意为“因此”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Therefore, in 1992 …。
therefore 意为“因此”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had therefore followed the staff。
therefore 意为“因此”，此处修饰形容词 necessary（必要）：was therefore necessary。
therefore 意为“所以”，此处修饰过去分词 kept：had therefore kept it twice。
therefore 意为“因此”，此处置于句末修饰动词：followed the staff therefore on the same day。
therefore 意为“因此”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 年头, he did it therefore with great care。
therefore 意为“所以”，被动结构 be kept therefore 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
therefore 意为“所以”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be therefore careful about the whole business。
therefore 意为“因此”，2002 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次随之而来那件短短的拐杖，副词置于动词之后。
therefore 意为“所以”，母亲 2004 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Therefore, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1992 年，长者所以在村口随之而来那件短短的拐杖；村子里人人都说那是头一回。（Therefore, …）
雨季到来之前，长者已经因此随之而来那件短短的拐杖。（had therefore followed …）
那件短短的拐杖当时因此必要。（therefore necessary）
保管它的那位后生在入冬前已经所以把它守着过两回。（had therefore kept it）
叔叔因此随之而来那件短短的拐杖，村子里没有一个人怀疑。（… therefore …）
在那个年头里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最因此。（the most therefore of all of them）
answers: Therefore, in 1992 the elder followed the staff at the gate.
Before the November rains the elder had therefore followed the staff.
The youth who kept it had therefore kept it twice before the winter came.
He followed the staff therefore on the same day, and nobody in the village doubted it.
Of all who did it that year, he did it therefore with great care.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 therefore 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Therefore, in 1992 the elder followed the staff, and nobody forgot it.
Before the November rains the elder had therefore followed the staff.
The staff was therefore necessary, or so the memoir says.
The youth had therefore kept it twice before the winter came.
My mother followed the staff therefore with great care when nobody else would.
Therefore, the village never forgot that part of the story.
